== Biography ==
Archibald was born in 1654. He is the son of [[Glasgow-3078|Archibald Glasgow]] and [[Watson-45727|Agnes Watson]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3078]] is assessed at 83% (probable). The held Archbald Glasgowe 1654 baptism citation is carried with an account naming Archibald Glasgow and Agnes Watson as parents. Archibald and Agnes Watson’s distinctive full couple and South Leith sequence favour the selected Archibald’s family. His 1618 Leith childhood is chronologically compatible with a 1654 child.

Probable full-profile continuity; the adult shoemaker and 1618 child have not been explicitly connected by a held kinship record.

Next useful test: Compare the Agnes Watson marriage and trade records with the 1618 family.
